duplicate_analysis.method: Two independently keyed 64-bit Pandas row fingerprints are combined to 128 bits and externally aggregated in SQLite; collision probability is negligible but not mathematically zero.

outlier_diagnostics.method: Deterministic systematic sample; all reported estimates are sample-only.

limitations: CSV source text is preserved. Numeric parsing is diagnostic only.
Outlier summaries and cardinality are systematic-sample estimates, not full-data counts.
Duplicate counts use a dual 64-bit row fingerprint. No records are removed.
A feature's physical semantics and CICFlowMeter implementation history do not prove why a specific row is anomalous.
